column1: # Pinned bytes of the writer cases in helper-pins.R (design section 7), per
# zlib version: Flate output can differ between zlib builds (zlib-ng). Every
# zlib listed has a row for every case. When a CI leg reports no pinned hash,
# add its rows from bytes_md5(pinned_cases[[case]]()) on that zlib.
# ubuntu-latest legs), computed in rocker/r-ver:4.5.1. 1.3.1: Rtools (CI's
# windows-latest leg), computed in Debian trixie's r-base:4.5.1, not on
# Windows itself. All three zlibs give the same bytes. On Windows itself,
# font_file differs with the same zlib and is skipped there (#89).
